howto.what: 当评估技术选型时，Claude会按8个维度（模式、范围、数据模型等）打分，总分低于4则自动继续，4分及以上则列出三个方案（保守、平衡、大胆）供你选择，并记录决策原因。
howto.when: 在Plan模式的第二阶段（技术分叉）自动触发，或当你要求评估技术选型、决定架构或有多重实现方案时手动调用。

howto.what_en: When evaluating technical options, Claude scores 8 dimensions (pattern, scope, etc.). If total < 4, auto-proceeds; if >=4, presents 3 options (conservative, balanced, bold) for human selection and records decision.
howto.when_en: Automatically triggered during Plan Mode Phase 2 (Technical Diverge) or manually when you ask to evaluate technical options, before committing to a pattern, or when multiple valid approaches exist.

say_en.note: Claude will score 8 dimensions and decide if human input is needed

say_en.text: Use tech-divergence to compare two options
say_en.note: Claude generates a scoring matrix and suggests a path
